mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline in periods where UNRATE exceeds 8.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline during two-quarter declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above baseline when INDPRO rises above 1% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above 3% and 4% respectively signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force (PAYEMS) above 0.5% for two consecutive months signals increased labor supply without corresponding demand growth, which compresses wage growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline when PAYEMS rises above 0.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline when HOUST falls below 1.2 million for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in both INDPRO and RSAFS above 1% and 2% respectively for two consecutive months signals improving supply capacity and rising corporate cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above baseline when INDPRO > 1% and RSAFS > 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
